entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [AI discovered CI] dotnet-new IntegrationTests hangs on macOS arm64 during AllCommonItemsCreate #57241
  • dotnet-watch BrowserTests.BrowserDiagnostics hangs on Windows Helix (test host blame-hang timeout) #57235
  • Add a composable exclusion property for default None items #57226
  • [CI triage] Hot Reload WebSocket initialization test times out on Windows FullFramework #57225
  • CA1515: account for MSTest test classes that need to remain public #57223

Closed

  • dotnet restore fails with 'error getting pack version: ...' when directory name contains @-sign and target is net8.0 #48981
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] The implicit runtime (8.0/9.0) for .NET 10.0.405 should be (8.0.34/9.0.23). #57219
  • Install .NET 9 from Ubuntu official jammy\noble source? #44835
  • .NET SDK flattens all assets under '\runtimes\win-<ARCH>\native' #49416
  • .NET Template Engine: Post-Action Fails with Missing 'executable' Argument #48829
  • Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite how to prevent all the runtime binaries from being emitted? #37147
  • Plumb cancellationtokens through all CLI commands for consistent behavior #56331
  • API proposal: OpenHarmonyCodesign MSBuild task #56759
    Backlog
